question: Can source-aware FLL projections avoid large localized-excursion corrections without imposing blanket frequency-drift delay?
retrospective_scope: Audit every retained application with absolute step at least 10 codes, and every selected window containing a per-span count residual of magnitude at least 2. Recorded trajectories are not counterfactual responses.
single_span_rule: Exactly one span has absolute residual at least 2 cycles, and the sum of all other residuals has magnitude at most 1 cycle. Separation subtracts that one contribution only from the derived FLL input; raw phase is retained. Confirmation withholds the whole proposal for one subsequent complete window under unchanged source identity, without applying a small step first.
blanket_rule: A nonzero FLL aggregate requires a previous complete same-sign FLL window in the same DAC and source epoch before an application. Zero-FLL phase decisions retain their existing path. Confirmation state resets on application or source discontinuity.
combined_rule: Use the gated segmented fit when available; otherwise a single-span-localized case follows the one-window whole-proposal confirmation rule. Nonlocalized unsupported fits retain the unchanged aggregate. No small phase action is issued before the confirmation window, so it cannot restart the 900s exclusion.

segmented_fit.model: Cumulative integer phase = intercept + slope*span_ordinal + one step. Compare against intercept+slope only.
segmented_fit.FLL_projection: Round fitted slope times 600 half away from zero into an integer-equivalent count residual only when all model gates pass; otherwise use the unchanged aggregate. Preserve raw closing phase.
segmented_fit.status: Exploratory model-selection constants, not a calibrated statistical test or operating thresholds.

synthetic_model.plant: Instantaneous code-to-frequency gain from the frozen characterized envelope; integer count quantization. No dynamic settling, hysteresis, ageing, stochastic receiver model or analog DAC readback is claimed.
synthetic_model.controller_path: Actual hybrid engine, tagged debt and application/first-consumer commit. Actual integer-count tight-band component. 900s measurement exclusion, 600-span windows, response frontier at or after 1500s and no correction at that frontier, 1800s minimum cadence. Metadata and reference remain qualified in performance cases.
synthetic_model.counterfactual_limit: Results after candidate divergence belong to the stated synthetic plant, never to replayed physical evidence.

matrix_generation: Full gain/count-phase/onset/sign grid for steps, ramps and localized reference-phase changes. Mixed cases use nominal gain, drift counts 1/3/6, both pulse signs and all declared widths. Counter glitches use nominal gain and all count phases/onsets/magnitudes/signs. Jitter challenges use nominal gain, count phases 0/0.5, onsets 1/300/600, both signs, jitter 0.4/1.5, and step=4, ramp=6, localized=4 at widths 1/30, mixed drift=3+pulse=4 width1, snapshot glitch=4. Quiet cases cover all gains/count phases/jitters. Performance times are measured in integer synthetic seconds; native decisions receive exact microsecond counters. First 25-percent reduction must persist for 600 consecutive synthetic seconds.
decision_rule: Report tradeoffs and worst cases by disturbance family, gain, count phase and boundary placement. Prefer a source-aware candidate only if it suppresses localized large corrections while distributed drift retains baseline-like response; expose mixed-case and boundary failures. Do not change constants after seeing this matrix. This study selects at most a next offline candidate, not a physical qualification or operating policy.
missing_or_contradictory_source: Reject the candidate model locally; do not fabricate zeros, change canonical validity, inhibit baseline control or modify historical records. No source window may span capture, acceptance or DAC identities.
